changelog:
xhs-copywriter v1.0.4 — Migrated, restructured, and expanded documentation and scripts

- Skill renamed to “xiaohongshu-write” with clarified description and use case.
- Major rewrite and extension of documentation (SKILL.md, README) for more detailed user guidance.
- New script added: scripts/fetch_xhs_hot_articles.py for fetching popular Xiaohongshu notes.
- Data field and output format specs added (references/xhs_hot_article_format.md).
- Removed obsolete/duplicated references and meta files.
- Strict, structured output format and workflow enforced for content generation.
